defs.def: to put sb/sth in a particular position, especially when it is done gently or carefully （尤指轻轻地或小心地）放置，安放，搁
to put sth down, especially on the floor, ready to be used 铺，铺放，铺设（尤指在地板上）

ex.s: With paper, there is a literal laying on of hands, along with the visual geography of distinct pages.
ex.t: 拿着纸书时，你能实实在在地用手翻阅，还能看到一页页分明的视觉布局。

defs.def: to spread sth on sth; to cover sth with a layer of sth （在某物上）摊开，涂，敷；用一层 … 覆盖

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

ex.s: The keyboard could offer a strong layer of security by analyzing things like the force of a user's typing and the time between key presses.
ex.t: 键盘可以通过分析诸如用户敲击的力度和按键间隔等，提供一层强大的安全性。

defs.def: if a bird, an insect, a fish, etc. lays eggs, it produces them from its body （鸟、昆虫、鱼等）下（蛋），产（卵）

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看他脱下篮球服、换上棒球服时，我看到他丢下了那层不再适合他的外壳，就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

ex.s: In the “unwilling” scenario, however, the dogs looked at the experimenter less often, sat, lay down and wandered around more frequently.
ex.t: 然而，在"不情愿"的情境中，狗看实验员的次数更少，坐下、躺下和四处走动的频率更高。

defs.def: to arrange knives, forks, plates, etc. on a table ready for a meal 摆放餐具（准备就餐）
to present a proposal, some information, etc. to sb for them to think about and decide on 提出，提交（建议、信息等）

ex.s: Other European countries laid down a similar requirement for immigrants, and some terms are even tougher.
ex.t: 14小时后，薄膜失去了13%的质量——显然是被蠕虫胃里的酶分解了。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.
ex.t: 美国国立卫生研究院2018年对4500名儿童进行的一项综合研究表明，每天盯着屏幕超过七小时的儿童，其大脑皮层的变薄迹象提前出现——大脑皮层是处理感官信息的外层。

defs.def: to put sb/sth in a particular position or state, especially a difficult or unpleasant one 使处于特定状态（尤指困境）
（与名词连用构成短语，其含义与该名词的相关动词相同）
to prepare sth in detail 周密准备；筹划；设置
to have sex with sb 与（某人）性交
to prepare a fire by arranging wood, sticks or coal （摆好木、柴或煤）生火
to bet money on sth; to place a bet 对 … 下赌金；下赌注

ex.s: It is horrible, is it not, next to your exquisite beauty!” There lay in the accents of the unfortunate man so significant an awareness of his sadness that she had not the strength to utter a syllable.
ex.t: 太可怕了，不是吗，在你精致的美丽旁边！“在这个不幸男子的口音中，蕴含着对他悲伤如此深切的体认，以至于她没有力气吐出一个音节。”

defs.def: to put sth on one side and not use it or think about it 把 … 放在一边（或搁置一旁）

ex.s: Then lay the tube in place so that one end rests all the way in the cup and the rest of the line runs up — and out — the side of the hole.
ex.t: 然后把管子放好，使一端一直伸到杯子里，管子的其余部分沿着孔的一侧向上——并伸出——孔外。

ex.s: A crack a hundred feet long lay open six inches wide in the middle of one street and then shut together again with such force, as to close up the earth like a narrow grave.
ex.t: 一条百英尺长的裂缝在一条街道中间裂开了六英寸宽，然后又以如此大的力量合拢，把大地闭合得像一个狭窄的坟墓。

defs.def: to keep sth to use, or deal with later 留存备用；留待以后处理
to put sth down or stop using it 放下；停止使用
to stop doing a job, etc. 中断（工作）；辞（职）；放弃
if you lay down a rule or a principle, you state officially that people must obey it or use it 规定，制订（条例或原则）

ex.s: Ancient people laid economic foundations for people today.
ex.t: 古代人为今天的人们奠定了经济基础。

ex.s: By mid-morning, hundreds lay dead in the water and amongst the tanks on the beach.
ex.t: 到了上午十点左右，数百具尸体躺在水中和海滩上的坦克之间。

defs.def: to produce sth that is stored and gradually increases 积存某物
to knock sb unconscious 把 … 打昏
to prepare a dead body to be buried （给死者）作殡葬准备
to spread sth out so that it can be seen easily or is ready to use 铺开；摆开；展开

ex.s: The underlined part "leaving behind the layer" in Paragraph 8 can be understood as       .
ex.t: 第8段中划线的"leaving behind the layer"可以理解为       。

defs.def: to plan how sth should look and arrange it in this way 布置；策划；安排；设计
to present a plan, an argument, etc. clearly and carefully 清晰谨慎地提出，策划（计划、论点等）
to spend money 花钱
if you lay up problems or trouble for yourself, you do sth that will cause you problems later 自找（麻烦）；自讨（苦吃）
to stop using a ship or other vehicle while it is being repaired （船或其他交通工具维修时）停止使用，搁置不用

ex.s: On the mornings that had once throbbed with the dawn chorus of robins, catbirds, doves, jays, wrens, and scores of other bird voices there was now no sound; only silence lay over the fields and woods and marsh.
ex.t: 在曾经伴随着知更鸟、猫鸟、鸽子、松鸦、鹪鹩和许多其他鸟鸣的黎明合唱而悸动的早晨，如今已了无生息；只有寂静笼罩着田野、树林和沼泽。

defs.def: not having expert knowledge or professional qualifications in a particular subject 外行的；非专业的；缺少专门知识的
not in an official position in the Church 平信徒的；在俗的
a partner in sex, especially a woman 性伙伴；（尤指）性交的女人
a poem that was written to be sung, usually telling a story （供吟唱的）叙事诗
the way the land in an area is formed and what physical characteristics it has 地貌；地势；地形
the way a situation is now and how it is likely to develop 目前的形势及发展趋势
